title: EXP-051 — Hello World Part 2: FX_Items Domain Validation and Three Test Records
objective: Using the existing FX_Items Web Client runtime Form, first establish that the FX_Items collection contains zero existing records through the EXP-042-R3/EXP-046 empty-criteria query and native status-bar count method. Open the FX_UM ComboBox read-only and verify that its displayed choices include EA / Each and DZ / Dozen, with FX_Description as the displayed description column where the native UI exposes that mapping. Then enter the first item, dumbbell / 45 pound iron / 45.00, with deliberately invalid FX_UM value BX, and attempt exactly one toolbar Save to capture the native validation rejection. If the invalid Save succeeds, stop immediately, preserve the resulting factory-owned row for separately authorized cleanup, and report the deviation. If rejected, correct FX_UM to EA through the ComboBox, add guitar / natural acoustic / 129.99 / EA and eggs / cage free / 6.99 / DZ one record at a time, and perform one successful explicit toolbar Save for the valid records. Finally, close and reopen the FX_Items runtime Form once, execute one empty-criteria query, and verify exactly three persisted records and their values. Record all evidence and classify any successful finding as observed, not replay_verified.

in_scope: Read AGENTS.md, EXP-050's accepted record and decisive evidence, EXP-042-R3 and EXP-046 emptiness and runtime-record procedures, and Hello World Part 2 sections 8–9 before browser interaction.

Inspect the inherited Web Client and Designer state read-only. Confirm the authenticated DEM configuration, the existing FX_Items runtime Form, and the User-scoped Form identity established in EXP-050. Do not change editing scope.

Establish the initial FX_Items collection-emptiness gate through one supported empty-criteria query and native loaded-record-count evidence. Do not infer emptiness from blank inputs or the inherited Item (Object 1 of 1) indication alone. Count rule (accepted in EXP-042-R3 and EXP-046) (operator decision 2026-10-10, accepted in EXP-042-R3): in add mode the status bar counts the uncommitted new-row placeholder as an object. Emptiness is established when, immediately after one empty-criteria query (Filter-in-Place F4 with empty criteria, or Refresh), ALL of the following hold: the grid shows exactly one row; that row carries the blue new-row star; both inputs are blank; and the status bar's count token reads exactly (Object 1 of 1). Clarification (operator, 2026-10-11, after T2): the status bar prefixes the count with the focused field's caption (observed: "Unit of Measure (Object 1 of 1)"); that caption prefix is expected and does not affect the gate. The count token in parentheses is what must match. Any unstarred row, any other count, or non-blank inputs closes the gate. After the Save and after the reopen query, the status bar should count exactly the three persisted records (plus the placeholder only if add mode is active; record the exact text and which applies). If the status bar is absent, record that and stop. On FX_Items the add-mode Cost input shows the property-class default 0.00 (EXP-050); that pre-filled default does not count as a non-blank input for this gate, all other inputs must be blank.

Open the FX_UM ComboBox list using its visible native dropdown control without choosing or changing a value. Capture the displayed code-description rows and available column headings, including EA / Each and DZ / Dozen if actually present.
Proceed to data entry only after the empty-collection and domain-list gates pass. If either is ambiguous, stop before mutation.
Enter exactly one initial draft with FX_Item=dumbbell, FX_Description=45 pound iron, FX_Cost=45.00, and FX_UM=BX using the native Web Client Form.
Attempt exactly one toolbar Save with BX present. Capture the exact native rejection message and the resulting Form state before dismissing any response. Do not invent the expected message text.

If the BX Save succeeds or persistence is ambiguous, stop without entering further items. Record the potential or confirmed persisted row and its required cleanup status; do not perform cleanup in this experiment.
If the invalid Save is rejected, use the FX_UM ComboBox to correct the first item's value to EA. Verify the remaining fields are unchanged.

Enter exactly two additional records, one at a time: guitar / natural acoustic / 129.99 / EA and eggs / cage free / 6.99 / DZ. Commit native field editors as required and inspect each draft's values before proceeding.

Invoke one successful explicit toolbar Save after the valid three-record set is ready. Capture the native result, clean state, and any automatic-save behavior encountered. Stop rather than performing an unplanned additional Save.

Close the clean FX_Items Web Client runtime Form once through its native tab control. Verify the runtime tab disappears, then reopen the same Form once through the supported Web Client Form-opening workflow.

After reopening, execute exactly one supported empty-criteria collection query, verify three loaded records, and inspect every row's four business-field values, with Cost displayed to two decimal places.

Capture screenshots and accessibility evidence under evidence/EXP-051/ for the preflight, empty gate, ComboBox rows, invalid draft, rejected Save message, corrected first row, other two draft rows, successful Save, closed state, reopened state, and three-row verification.
Write a single experiment record under experiments/ and concise task evidence reports under evidence/EXP-051/. Audit operation counts, preservation boundaries, and repository confinement.

acceptance_checks.description: Preflight evidence identifies the usable Mongoose Web Client, DEM configuration, exact FX_Items Form, and its established User-scoped Designer identity. No authentication challenge, unexpected dialog, or pending mutation is present before controlled work.

Before any data entry, the supported empty-criteria query establishes zero existing FX_Items records using a captured native loaded-record-count indication. The screenshot identifies FX_Items and the settled query result. Blank input controls alone do not pass this gate.

The FX_UM ComboBox is opened once read-only. Captured visible rows establish EA / Each and DZ / Dozen, and the description-column identity where exposed. The list is dismissed without selecting or changing any value. Unexpected or ambiguous list contents close the mutation gate.

Exactly one initial FX_Items draft visibly contains dumbbell, 45 pound iron, Cost 45.00, and invalid FX_UM BX before one toolbar Save. The captured native result explicitly rejects the invalid unit. If Save succeeds or its outcome is ambiguous, AC-4 fails and the experiment stops, with the resulting row or uncertainty documented for separately authorized cleanup.

Following a proven rejection, the same dumbbell draft visibly contains FX_UM EA selected through the ComboBox, while FX_Item, FX_Description, and FX_Cost retain their original values. No additional invalid-code Save is attempted.

The guitar record is entered through the supported native Form workflow with exact values FX_Item=guitar, FX_Description=natural acoustic, FX_Cost=129.99, FX_UM=EA. Evidence identifies the current draft and all four values before final submission.

The eggs record is entered through the supported native Form workflow with exact values FX_Item=eggs, FX_Description=cage free, FX_Cost=6.99, FX_UM=DZ. Evidence identifies the current draft and all four values before final submission. No fourth item is added.

After the valid three-record set is prepared, exactly one intended successful toolbar Save yields a captured native success and clean Form state. Any implicit commits or unexpected Save prompts are explicitly audited rather than silently counted as ordinary field navigation.

Exactly one ordinary clean runtime Form-tab close removes FX_Items from the open tab list, followed by exactly one supported reopening of FX_Items. Captured evidence establishes the same Form identity and no unexpected authentication or unsaved-change prompt.

After reopening, one empty-criteria query yields exactly three loaded FX_Items rows, with no unexplained extra row. Native row-by-row inspection proves dumbbell / 45 pound iron / 45.00 / EA, guitar / natural acoustic / 129.99 / EA, and eggs / cage free / 6.99 / DZ. The native loaded-record count and all three row identities are captured.

The final audit reconciles one BX invalid-Save attempt, at most one intended successful toolbar Save, exactly three intended valid item records, one runtime close, one runtime reopen, and one final empty-criteria query. It records any automatic-save behavior, timeout, unexpected prompt, or deviation from these counts.

Evidence and action logs support confinement to the existing FX_Items runtime records and EXP-051 documentation/evidence. No intentional changes to FX_UMs rows, IDOs, SQL definitions, property classes, caption strings, vendor Forms, or source-control state occurred. Preservation evidence limitations and repository-audit limitations are stated explicitly.

initial_instruction: T1 — Read AGENTS.md, the accepted EXP-050 record, relevant EXP-042-R3 and EXP-046 emptiness procedures, and Hello World Part 2 sections 8–9. Inspect the inherited FX_Items runtime Form and live session without changing data. Establish the initial collection-emptiness gate through the supported empty-criteria query and native status-bar count. Only if that gate passes, inspect the FX_UM ComboBox list read-only and capture the actual displayed choices and column headings. Capture decisive evidence under evidence/EXP-051/, write a concise T1 report, and create the single EXP-051 experiment record. Stop before entering dumbbell, typing BX, or invoking any toolbar Save. If either gate fails or the UI state is ambiguous, record the blocker and preserve the current state. Subsequent data-entry operations require separate coordinator authorization.
notes: Proposed by the coordinator after run R-20261011-034347-PXmt. Rationale: EXP-050 accepted the User-scoped FX_Items Multi-View Form, verified the four runtime fields and captions, and directly observed that FX_UM renders as a ComboBox. The next tutorial section tests the ComboBox's list contents, invalid-unit rejection, and runtime record persistence. This experiment confines that lifecycle to the existing factory-owned FX_Items objects and exactly three specified test items. The read-only emptiness and domain-list gates precede all data mutation, and the invalid-save attempt is a hard stop if it unexpectedly succeeds. | Operator review: the accepted EXP-042-R3/EXP-046 status-bar count rule added to the emptiness gate (with the caption-prefix clarification and the EXP-050 pre-filled Cost default 0.00 exception); exact-value guard (FX_Items, dumbbell, 45 pound iron, guitar, natural acoustic, eggs, cage free, BX, EA, DZ) and no-JavaScript policy added. Operator decision: eggs Cost fixed as 6.99 (the transcript's spoken '699'). Approved by the operator 2026-10-11 with precondition attestation: logged in, configuration OK, Web Client loaded, no unsaved changes.
